import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int N;
    static ModInt[][] probability = new ModInt[10][10];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p).div(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masksWithCount.get(count).size();
            masksWithCount.get(count).add(mask);
        }

        Map<Long, ModInt> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        long firstKey = 1L << lookup[0];
        possibleMasks.put(firstKey, new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<Long, ModInt> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
            ModInt[] products = new ModInt[1 << N];
            Arrays.fill(products, new ModInt(1));

            for (int current = 0; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                ModInt prod = new ModInt(1);
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++) {
                    if (((current >> right) & 1) == 1) {
                        prod = prod.mul(probability[left][right]);
                    } else {
                        prod = prod.mul(ModInt.one().sub(probability[left][right]));
                    }
                }
                products[current] = prod;
            }

            long[] newBits = new long[N];
            Arrays.fill(newBits, 0L);
            long[] newPossible = new long[1 << N];

            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                long possibleMask = entry.getKey();
                ModInt prob = entry.getValue();

                Arrays.fill(newBits, 0L);

                for (int mask : masksWithCount.get(left)) {
                    if (((possibleMask >> lookup[mask]) & 1) == 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                long newMask = (long) lookup[mask | (1 << i)];
                                newBits[i] |= 1L << newMask;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                long[] newPossibleArr = new long[1 << N];
                Arrays.fill(newPossibleArr, 0L);

                for (int current = 1; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                    int ctz = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(current);
                    newPossibleArr[current] = newPossibleArr[current & (current - 1)] | newBits[ctz];
                    long key = newPossibleArr[current];
                    ModInt val = newPossibleMasks.getOrDefault(key, new ModInt(0));
                    newPossibleMasks.put(key, val.add(prob.mul(products[current])));
                }
            }
            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
            System.err.println(possibleMasks.size());
        }

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);
        long lastBit = 1L << lookup[(1 << N) - 1];
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> p : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
            if (((p.getKey() >> lookup[(1 << N) - 1]) & 1) == 1) {
                answer = answer.add(p.getValue());
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer.intValue());
    }

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        public ModInt(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            this.val = (int) v;
        }

        public static ModInt one() {
            return new ModInt(1);
        }

        public ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            int res = this.val + other.val;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        public ModInt sub(ModInt other) {
            int res = this.val - other.val;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        public ModInt mul(ModInt other) {
            long res = (long) this.val * other.val % MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        public ModInt div(ModInt other) {
            return this.mul(other.inv());
        }

        public ModInt inv() {
            return new ModInt(modInverse(this.val, MOD));
        }

        public int intValue() {
            return this.val;
        }

        private static int modInverse(int a, int m) {
            int m0 = m, t, q;
            int x0 = 0, x1 = 1;

            if (m == 1)
                return 0;

            while (a > 1) {
                q = a / m;
                t = m;
                m = a % m;
                a = t;
                t = x0;
                x0 = x1 - q * x0;
                x1 = t;
            }

            if (x1 < 0)
                x1 += m0;

            return x1;
        }
    }
}
